announcements.headline: Result of EGM
announcements.insight: The EGM result follows the October notice of a proposed capital reorganisation. Shareholders should note the outcome of this structural change.

announcements.headline: Proposed Capital Reorganisation & Notice of EGM
announcements.insight: Ormonde Mining (CDI) has issued a notice of EGM to propose a capital reorganisation. This follows the posting of the annual report and AGM results in August and September.

announcements.headline: Interim Results
announcements.insight: Interim Results follow the Final Results posted in June. Shareholders should review the interim performance relative to the prior year-end figures.

announcements.headline: Result of AGM
announcements.insight: The AGM results follow the posting of the Annual Report in August. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for any governance changes.

announcements.headline: Posting of Annual Report and Notice of AGM
announcements.insight: Shareholders should note the posting of the Annual Report following the June results. The July Peak Nickel update may provide context for the upcoming AGM proceedings.

announcements.headline: Investee Company Update: Peak Nickel
announcements.insight: Ormonde Mining provides an update on its investee, Peak Nickel. This follows the final results announced in June.

announcements.headline: Final Results
announcements.insight: Ormonde Mining (CDI) has released its final results. Shareholders should review these figures for performance indicators.
